posts.title: Setting up Encrypted ZFS on NetBSD
posts.description: I just set up an encrypted ZFS volume on my NetBSD install. This is my journal on how I did it. I’m using a zpool on top of NetBSD’s cgd Cryptographic Disk layer (similar to LUKS on linux), because NetBSD’s ZFS does not have ZFS’s native encryption available. Most of this post is about setting up cgd.
